snippet.title: Everdream Village | Early Access Launch Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
🌾 Everdream Village – Now in Early Access! 🌾

Your cozy adventure begins today! Become the new Mayor, build your Village, explore new islands, meet quirky NPCs, raise and breed adorable animals, sail the seas, uncover secrets… and help shape the game’s future. 💛

🎮 Play Everdream Village on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3569950/Everdream_Village/

🌿 Join our official Discord community:
https://discord.gg/DrjKasu89E

📘 Find the full Roadmap, Treasure Hunt details & Beaver Milestones here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3569950/view/519732709746016558?l=english
